### The Day Grace Rode Into Town
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-24-2024.html
Passage: Matthew 21:9
Points:
- Jesus rode into Jerusalem on Palm Sunday fully aware that the cheering crowd would demand His crucifixion days later.
- The people cried "Hosanna" seeking deliverance from Rome, but Jesus came to rescue humanity from sin and death.
- Pure grace moved Christ toward the cross despite knowing the accolades would soon become insults.
- Modern believers often mirror the crowd's fickleness by praising God one day and doubting Him the next.
- In spite of human weakness and wavering trust, Christ continually extends His inexhaustible grace.
